title: Canonical cyclic module coefficients on a sheaf killed by n
statement: Let T be a scheme, n a natural number, and F an abelian etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] with n times its identity zero. There exists a sheaf G of modules over ULift(Z/nZ) whose underlying abelian sheaf [def-pur-etale-module-abelian-forget] is isomorphic to F. The action is the canonical action on each group of sections; no arbitrary unproved witness is chosen.

source.place: Tag 0F1I, lemma-punctual-base-change, degree-zero and bounded-exponent reductions; Tag 073E, filtered colimits

proof.text: Evaluate the identity n id F=0 on each etale chart. AddCommGroup.zmodModule gives the canonical ZMod n action. All additive restriction maps are linear (AddMonoidHom.toZModLinearMap). Restrict scalars along the ULift ring equivalence. Forgetting to types gives precisely the original sheaf presheaf, so its sheaf condition gives the module sheaf condition, and the identity gives the desired underlying isomorphism.
